lines.text: Riyadh's independent car market trades billions of riyals a year.
And no one had ever counted it.
So we walked it. Door to door. Five hundred and twenty showrooms.
We did not guess. We photographed the floors, and read the prices on the windscreens.
Stock, prices and presentation. All seen in person.
Every showroom pinned at its coordinates, and logged on one master sheet.
Five hundred and twenty showrooms. Five hundred and fourteen, pinned on the map.
Thirty one thousand, eight hundred and sixty nine cars on the floor. Three point six billion riyals of stock.
Twenty five owners opened their books.
Al Qaadiseeya alone sells an estimated fifteen point seven billion riyals of cars a year. And that is the conservative figure.
When the finance is not there, the sale walks out of the door.
Owners told us: for every ten cars they sell, about four more ready buyers leave without one.
No one else holds this. The largest sub-dealer mapping of its kind, on one standard.
AutoLink brings financing to your floor.
Your team submits the buyer's request in the AutoLink dealer portal, and follows it, step by step.
Requests, reports and your account, in one dashboard.
In Arabic, in English, or in Chinese.
And the lenders are coming with us.
Saudi Arabia's leading banks and finance companies, partnering with AutoLink.
And it is already moving.
In one month, twenty sub-dealers signed with AutoLink. Sixteen more agreements are out for signature, and sixty four are in the pipeline.
We are at the table with eighteen banks and finance companies.
